credentialRequirements.description: An OAuth access token for the official hosted Vercel MCP server. The Credential Adapter must retain the token and execute the hosted MCP request; the token must never be disclosed to the proposer.

buy_addon.description: Executes a Vercel add-on purchase (currently only "siem"), by integer quantity, previously quoted by get_purchase_quote — quoting first is REQUIRED; this tool rejects un-quoted calls. Get the quote, present it to the user for explicit approval (use a structured question tool such as AskUserQuestion when available), then call with confirm:true, the quote's idempotencyKey, and the same parameters. The team must be on the Flex plan. No price quote exists for add-ons; the charge is non-refundable.

productAlias.description: The add-on to purchase. Only "siem" is available today.

teamId.description:
The team ID to get the deployment events for. Alternatively the team slug can be used.
Team IDs start with "team_".
If you do not know the team ID or slug, it can be found through these mechanism:
- Read the file .vercel/project.json if it exists and extract the orgId
- Use the `list_teams` tool

confirm.description: Set true to execute the charge; requires the idempotencyKey from get_purchase_quote.

buy_credits.description: Executes a prepaid Vercel credits purchase (v0, AI Gateway, or Vercel Agent) previously quoted by get_purchase_quote — quoting first is REQUIRED; this tool rejects un-quoted calls. Get the quote, present it to the user for explicit approval (use a structured question tool such as AskUserQuestion when available), then call with confirm:true, the quote's idempotencyKey, and the same parameters. When the user has not named an amount, offer quick-picks — $10, $25, $50, or $100 — or let them enter any custom amount ($1–$1000); do not just quote the range. Some credit types require a plan: Vercel Agent credits require the team to be on Vercel Pro (use buy_pro first), and v0 credits require a paid v0 plan (set up at v0.dev); AI Gateway credits have no plan prerequisite. If the required plan is missing the purchase is rejected (nothing is charged) with guidance. The charge is immediate and non-refundable.

creditType.description: Which credit balance to top up: v0, gateway (AI Gateway), or agent (Vercel Agent).

amount.description: Amount to purchase, in whole US dollars (1–1000).

teamId.description:

confirm.description: Set true to execute the charge; requires the idempotencyKey from get_purchase_quote.

buy_domain.description: Executes a single-domain registration previously quoted by get_purchase_quote (product:domain) — quoting first is REQUIRED; this tool rejects un-quoted calls. Get the quote, present it to the user for explicit approval (use a structured question tool such as AskUserQuestion when available), then call with confirm:true, the quote's idempotencyKey, the expectedPrice and years from the quote, and the full registrant contact to execute the non-refundable purchase. Vercel stores no reusable registrant profile, so contact details must be supplied each time.

years.description: Registration term in years. Required on confirm — must match the term shown in the quote.

autoRenew.description: Whether to auto-renew at the end of the term. Defaults to true.

expectedPrice.description: Required on confirm: the purchasePrice (USD) from the quote. The server rejects the order if it no longer matches the live price.

contact.description: Registrant (WHOIS) contact. Not needed for the quote; REQUIRED on confirm. All fields must be provided.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. US

buy_pro.description: Executes a Vercel Pro upgrade previously quoted by get_purchase_quote — quoting first is REQUIRED; this tool rejects un-quoted calls. This starts RECURRING Pro billing immediately at the standard Pro price.

deploy_to_vercel.description: Deploy files directly to a new Vercel project — no git repo and no CLI needed. Provide the file tree and an explicit target; Vercel auto-detects the framework and builds. Best for shipping an app you just generated.

target.description: Required. "preview" for a shareable non-production URL, or "production" to go live.

name.description: Project name. Vercel creates the project if it does not already exist.

data.description: File contents: plain text, or base64 when encoding is "base64".

encoding.description: Content encoding. Defaults to "utf-8"; use "base64" for binary files.

files.description: The file tree to deploy. Source files only — Vercel installs deps and builds.

teamId.description:
The team ID to get the deployment events for. Alternatively the team slug can be used.
Team IDs start with "team_".
If you do not know the team ID or slug, it can be found through these mechanism:
- Read the file .vercel/project.json if it exists and extract the orgId
- Use the `list_teams` tool

projectSettings.description: Optional build settings. Omit to let Vercel auto-detect the framework.

get_access_to_vercel_url.description:
Creates a temporary shareable link that bypasses authentication for protected Vercel deployments.

  When you encounter a Vercel deployment URL (like https://myapp-abc123.vercel.app), 
  you might receive a 403 (Forbidden) error when trying to access it. 

  This tool generates a special URL with a '_vercel_share' parameter that allows temporary access 
  without requiring login credentials. The shareable URL will expire in 23 hours.
  
  When you use the returned URL, that URL will redirect and set an auth cookie.
  If your fetch implementation does not support cookies, use the 'web_fetch_vercel_url' tool instead.

url.description: The full URL of the Vercel deployment (e.g. "https://myapp.vercel.app").

import-claude-design-from-url.description: Import a design into Vercel from a publicly fetchable URL. The file is a self-contained HTML bundle with all images, fonts, and styles inlined.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL to the design file. Valid for ~1 hour. Fetched server-side.

title.description: Suggested title for the imported design.

claude_design_project_id.description: Stable Claude Design project identifier. Reuse it to update the same imported Vercel project.

update_project_deployment_protection.description: Partially update password protection, Vercel Authentication, and Trusted IPs for a Vercel project. Omitted settings are preserved. Availability depends on the Vercel team plan and caller permissions.

password.description: The new password. This value is write-only and redacted.

ssoProtection.description: Enable or disable Vercel Authentication. Omit to preserve the current setting.

deploymentType.description: Where protection applies: all deployments, previews only, or production deployment URLs and all previews.

trustedIps.description: Enable or disable Trusted IPs. Omit to preserve the current setting.

protectionMode.description: Whether an IP match is required in addition to other protection or can bypass it.
